description: This file defines the final class PumpStream in the GuzzleHttp\Psr7 namespace, implementing a read-only stream that pumps data from a PHP callable. It includes methods for reading data, managing stream metadata, and controlling stream position, specifically designed to handle streaming data through a callback function.

classes.name: PumpStream
classes.description: A final class implementing a read-only stream that sources its data from a PHP callable, supporting stream operations such as reading, size retrieval, and metadata access.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PumpStream with a callable source and optional stream settings, including size and metadata.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Converts the stream content to a string by copying all data from the stream.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the stream, detaching its data source.

methods.name: detach
methods.description: Detaches the data source and resets position indicator.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the stream if known.

methods.name: tell
methods.description: Returns the current position in the stream.

methods.name: eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: isSeekable
methods.description: Indicates that the stream cannot be seeked.

methods.name: rewind
methods.description: Rewinds the stream, which is implemented as seeking to position zero.

methods.name: seek
methods.description: Throws an exception as seeking is not supported.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Throws an exception because writing is not supported.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads a specified number of bytes from the buffer, pumping more data if needed.

methods.name: getContents
methods.description: Reads all remaining data from the stream into a string.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns stream metadata or a specific metadata value if a key is provided.
